page.overview:
Who is Kanata Ubuyashiki?

Kanata was a girl with a pale, light skin and a set of large, purple eyes. Her hair was shaped into a blunt white bob haircut similar to the rest of her siblings. She adorned an elongated wisteria headpiece on the right side of her head as opposed to the left side like her brother.

During Final Selection, Kanata wore a purple, flower-patterned Hōmongi kimono with a dark indigo juban under it. She also sported a sheen green obi with a dark indigo obiage and a plum-red obijime tying it.

During the events in the Infinity Castle, Kanata wore a purple Edo komon kimono with a white juban under it, sporting a black obi with a white obiage and a pink obijime, completely identical to her twin sister Kuina Ubuyashiki.

Kanata's first appearance during the Final Selection depicts herself to be a professional, intelligent, and focused individual on her given task of explaining the proper details regarding the exam.
